observations.original_synopsis_draft: A creature capable of changing its form puts the Enterprise crew at risk in its search for salt.
A mysterious creature endangers an important mining operation.
Kirk suspects that a Shakespearean performer may be concealing responsibility for mass murder.
A teenager with extraordinary abilities causes dangerous upheaval aboard the Enterprise.
The Enterprise rescues Harry Mudd, a con artist traveling with a group of women.
An infection disrupts the Enterprise crew's ability to restrain their behavior.
A transporter accident produces a threatening counterpart of Captain Kirk.
A newly introduced psychiatric treatment proves to have deadly consequences.
An attack on an outpost draws the Enterprise into a confrontation with Romulan forces.
Several Enterprise officers find themselves in a parallel version of reality.
Beings from outside the galaxy seize the Enterprise to carry them toward their distant home.
The Enterprise becomes entangled in a computerized conflict between two worlds.
Scotty becomes a suspect in a murder investigation with disturbing historical parallels.
Klingon arms shipments upset a fragile balance of power on a previously peaceful world.
A hostile influence secretly manipulates the actions of a group of children.
The Enterprise crew is held captive by aliens intent on conquest.
